verdict.rationale: LegalZoom is a SaaS that holds sensitive user data and ships AI features such as AI-powered meeting minutes, so an opt-out from AI model training is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack shows any setting, policy, or commitment that keeps user data out of AI training. The llms.txt probe only gives guidance to AI crawlers about the public website and says nothing about how customer data is used.
